summary: Frontend verification of the new Tables MAP redesign, editable tables text (super admin settings round-trip), event photo gallery uploader, and past-events lightbox. All four features work end-to-end. Verified on desktop (1920) and mobile (390) with no horizontal overflow.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard.js is 957 lines - approaching threshold; managers (Events/Menu/Gallery/Users/etc.) should be split into separate files for maintainability.
Landing.js should also be reviewed for length once new sections have stabilised.

Event gallery upload uploads files one-by-one via multiple submit events; multi-file input select would need users to pick one image at a time (input has no 'multiple' attr). Consider adding multiple to <input type='file'> for true multi-upload UX (spec calls out 'multi-upload').
seed_data_creation: Created a TEST_Gallery_Event with 2 uploaded images to verify gallery persistence; cleaned up (DELETE returned 200). Left 'Harvest Moon Supper' demo untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 requested features validated. Tables map renders premium floor-plan with dashed zones, seat dots, legend '7 tables in total', 'Indoor' (Spicy/Umami/Salty/Tangy => 4 tables · up to 4 guests) and 'Garden · Outdoor' (Smoky/Fruity/Malty => 3 tables · up to 6 guests). No overflow at 1920 nor 390. Settings round-trip PASS: changing tables_label/heading/intro via admin (data-testids setting-tables-label/-heading/-intro + save-settings-btn) persists and homepage #tables reflects changes after reload; restored originals afterwards. Event gallery uploader (event-gallery-upload) inside Owner settings > Upcoming events dialog works: uploaded 2 images -> POST /api/admin/upload returned URLs, GET /api/admin/events showed gallery array of 2. Past-events section shows 'Ganesha' (no gallery) and 'Harvest Moon Supper' with 3-image strip [data-testid='past-event-gallery-<id>']; clicking a thumb opens [data-testid='event-lightbox'] full-screen overlay, clicking overlay closes it. Upcoming events (2026-09-20, 2026-09-27, 2026-10-04) correctly do NOT appear in past section.
